{{Quote|Haor Chall Engineering ''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle. Design is based on the soldier beetles. Upraised stern, bow ramp, clawfoot landing gear. Gunray's named it the ''Lapiz Cutter''.|A [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]]|<ref name="Labyrinth of Evil">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref>}}
The '''''Lapiz Cutter''''' was the personal [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|''Sheathipede''-class shuttle]] of [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]]. He utilized the ship to land on [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|conquered]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], to flee from [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], to visit potential [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] ally [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]] on [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] during the same year, and to flee [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] during a [[Siege of Cato Neimoidia|Republic attack]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].

==History==
[[File:LapizCutter.jpg|thumb|left|The ''Lapiz Cutter'' on Naboo]]
The ''Lapiz Cutter'' was [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray's]] personal [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|''Sheathipede''-class shuttle]]. The cockpit of the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] had been removed and an integrated [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brain]] added to pilot the ship so cabin space could be increased. The ''Lapiz Cutter'' had powerful shields.<ref name="Databank">{{DB|starship|neimoidianshuttle|Neimoidian shuttle}}</ref>

[[File:NeimoidianGroundCrewmen.jpg|thumb|right|The ''Lapiz Cutter'' on Geonosis]]
The viceroy used the shuttle to land on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] after it was [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invaded]]<ref name="Databank" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]<ref name="Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> and to leave the planet after the end of the battle that had taken place.<ref name="The Phantom Menace">{{Film|I}}</ref> He also used the shuttle to escape the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] attack during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]]<ref name="Databank" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="Chronology" /> 

Later that same year, the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] had been repainted in grey and blue, the colors of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Afterwards, Gunray used the craft to travel to [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], the ship being accompanied by two [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]], after [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]] had helped in the [[Mission to Rodia/Legends|capture]] of Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. The viceroy intended to oversee the execution of Senator Amidala, but she managed to escape during a battle with the help of [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] and a [[Kwazel Maw/Legends|Kwazel Maw]].<ref name="Bombad Jedi">{{TCW|Bombad Jedi}}</ref> Gunray wanted to escape, but the Kwazel Maw shoved the ''Lapiz Cutter'' into a lagoon.<ref name="Bombad Jedi Decoded">{{TCW|Bombad Jedi|d=y}}</ref> The vessel was later recovered, and Gunray again used it to escape from [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] at the conclusion of the [[Siege of Cato Neimoidia|Battle of Cato Neimoidia]].<ref name="Labyrinth of Evil" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith (video game)|''Revenge of the Sith'' video game]], Gunray escaped [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] in the Separatist control center on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] and attempted to flee in ''Lapiz Cutter'', which was destroyed by plunging into the lava river beneath after a short battle with former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].

[[The LEGO Group]] made a set of the ''Lapiz Cutter'' called 8036 "Separatist Shuttle" released on [[June 28]], [[2009]]. A miniature version was included in 9509 Star Wars Advent Calendar, released August 2012.
